Name: Yuzu More Factory
Author: Yuzu17
Description:
[font=Courier New][b][color=#e06666][size=5]More Factory[/size][/color]
[size=4]Adds shared ingredients, supplies, and production equipment for Yuzu’s artisan food mods.[/size]
[size=4]More Factory provides the common resources and systems these mods use. Finished products and their recipes are added by the individual food mods.[/size]
[size=4]Install More Factory and its requirements, then choose the supported food mods you want to use. You don’t need to install every food mod.[/size]
[size=4]Check each food mod’s page for any additional requirements.[/size][/b][/font]



[font=Courier New][b][b][color=#00ffff][size=5]Installation instructions[/size][/color]
[/b][/b][/font]
[list]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4][b]Download and unzip the file.[/b][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4][b]Place the extracted folder directly into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.[/b][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[*][font=Courier New][b][size=4][b]Keep the folder structure as it is.[/b][/size][/b][/font][/*]
[/list][font=Courier New][b][size=4][b][color=#ffff00]Do not move or extract the individual mod folders from their parent folder.[/color][/b] [/size][/b][/font]
